name: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset
description: The EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset is an electroencephalographic benchmark collected by the Wadsworth Center, New York State Department of Health, using the BCI2000 research platform. The dataset consists of over 1,500 one- and two-minute 64-channel EEG recordings (sampled at 160 Hz according to the international 10-10 system) obtained from 109 healthy volunteers. Participants performed motor execution and mental imagery tasks, including opening and closing left or right fists, imagining hand movements, and moving both feet. The dataset provides continuous event annotations, serving as a primary benchmark for motor imagery classification, Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) decoding, and neuroprosthetic control.
